title: Projection/exchange coherence for compact support
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring, let $u:T\to U$ be a separated finite-type morphism of schemes, and let $v:U'\to U$ be arbitrary [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Form the Cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] with $T'=T\times_UU'$, $w:T'\to T$ and $u':T'\to U'$. Supply a compactification $c=(j,p)$, with $j:T\hookrightarrow\overline T$ a quasi-compact open immersion and $p:\overline T\to U$ proper, $pj=u$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], and its base change $c'=(j',p')$, with $\bar w:\overline T'=\overline T\times_UU'\to\overline T$. No separatedness of $T,U,U'$ over a field or of $v$ is assumed.

Use the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(V_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ of constant discrete module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], the operations and adjunctions $a^*\dashv Ra_*$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], derived tensor [def-weil-derived-tensor], and exact extension by zero [def-weil-extension-by-zero]. Put $F_u^c=Rp_*j_!$ and $F_{u'}^{c'}=Rp'_*j'_!$. Define $E_u^c:v^*F_u^c\to F_{u'}^{c'}w^*$ as proper unit--square--counit exchange followed by $Rp'_*$ of $\bar w^*j_!\cong j'_!w^*$. Define $\operatorname{PF}_{u,N,P}^c:F_u^cN\otimes^LP\to F_u^c(N\otimes^Lu^*P)$ as the counit-defined proper projection transformation followed by $Rp_*$ of $j_!N\otimes^Lp^*P\cong j_!(N\otimes^Lj^*p^*P)$ and $j^*p^*\cong u^*$. These are precisely the finite-level chosen-compactification formulas written in [def-exchange-projection], here with arbitrary $v$.

For all $N\in D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ and $P\in D(U_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$, these specified maps satisfy
$$
E_u^c(N\otimes^Lu^*P)\circ v^*\operatorname{PF}_{u,N,P}^c
=\operatorname{PF}_{u',w^*N,v^*P}^{c'}\circ(E_u^c(N)\otimes1),
$$
after inserting the canonical pullback/tensor and pullback-composition comparisons on the source and target. The equality is natural in $N,P$ and asserts no invertibility of exchange or projection.

proof.text: Write $G=v^*$, $H=\bar w^*$, $V=w^*$, $R=Rp_*$, $R'=Rp'_*$. Work in the ordinary unbounded module derived categories over the constant sheaf $\Lambda$. The operations and adjunctions in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] are those for these ringed topoi, with coefficient identifications induced by inverse image of the constant ring. The Cartesian scheme diagram induces the specified commutation of ringed-topos morphisms, compatible with these identifications. Use $\mu_a:a^*(A\otimes^LB)\cong a^*A\otimes^La^*B$ of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] and the canonical composition comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition]. Let $e:GR\to R'H$ be the mate of $p'^*G\cong Hp^*$, and let $\pi_p$ be the proper projection transformation defined in the item. For $Q\in D(\overline T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ put $b_N:Hj_!N\cong j'_!VN$ and $\gamma_j(N,Q):j_!N\otimes^LQ\cong j_!(N\otimes^Lj^*Q)$. By [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization], these are exactly the canonical open base-change and tensor maps in the item, with identity restrictions under the open units, and $j'_!$ is fully faithful. This theorem is applied only to constant finite ring sheaves, not to its additional strict-system assertion.

source.place: Tag 07A7 (remark-base-change), Tag 07A4 (lemma-pullback-tensor-product), and Tag 0GL1 (lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor); notation and ringed-topos specialization

proof.text:
Apply [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-exchange-tensor-coherence] to the square with vertical maps $p,p'$ and horizontal maps $v,\bar w$, at $A=j_!N$ and $P$. Its exchange is $e$: it is the mate of the same pullback comparison under the same derived adjunctions. Its projection maps are $\pi_p,\pi_{p'}$: both are the specified adjuncts of counit tensor identity. Thus, with source and target tensor comparisons inserted, the theorem gives
$$e_{A\otimes^Lp^*P}\,G\pi_p(A,P)=\pi_{p'}(HA,GP)(e_A\otimes1).$$
It applies to arbitrary unbounded objects and commutative ring sheaves. In particular neither proper-base-change invertibility nor a finite Tor-amplitude condition is being used.

source.place: Tag 0E48 (remark-compatible-with-diagram); the cited existing node supplies its omitted verification

proof.text:
For any $Q$ on $\overline T$, the open comparison identity is
$$b_{N\otimes^Lj^*Q}\,H\gamma_j(N,Q)=\gamma_{j'}(VN,HQ)(b_N\otimes1),$$
where the source comparison is $\mu_H$ and the target uses $\mu_w$ and $Vj^*\cong j'^*H$. To check it, [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization] identifies the common source $H(j_!N\otimes^LQ)$ with $j'_!(VN\otimes^Lj'^*HQ)$ by $\mu_H$, $b_N\otimes1$, and $\gamma_{j'}$. Its target is also in the essential image of $j'_!$. Full faithfulness therefore reduces equality to equality after $j'^*$. The restrictions of $b$ and $\gamma$ are identities under the stated open units. The remaining maps agree directly under the canonical tensor and composition comparisons: on K-flat representatives supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], both maps in bidegree $(r,s)$ take the inverse image of $x\otimes y$ to the tensor of the inverse images of $x$ and $y$, with $Vj^*y=j'^*Hy$. The composition comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition] is the termwise pullback comparison, so it gives exactly this identification. These maps preserve bidegrees and the total differential and hence give the same map of total tensor complexes, locally on sheaf tensor generators and therefore globally. Passing to the derived category proves the restricted equality, and full faithfulness proves the displayed identity.

source.place: Tag 0GL1 (lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor), with sites-modules.tex Tag 0E8I (lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor); explicit open restriction calculation

proof.text:
Put $A=j_!N$, $C=A\otimes^Lp^*P$, $W=N\otimes^Lu^*P$, and let $\gamma:C\to j_!W$ include $j^*p^*\cong u^*$. Write $\gamma'$ for the analogous map with inputs $VN,GP$ and $p'^*GP$. Step 3 at $Q=p^*P$, with $Hp^*P\cong p'^*GP$, says $b_W H\gamma=\gamma'(b_N\otimes1)$. The pullback comparisons here identify $Vj^*p^*P$ with $j'^*Hp^*P$ and then with $j'^*p'^*GP$; these are the identifications of $Vu^*P$ with $u'^*GP$ in the item. Expand the definitions of $E^c$ and $\operatorname{PF}^c$. Naturality of the exchange transformation $e$ of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-exchange-tensor-coherence], applied to $\gamma:C\to j_!W$, gives
$$\begin{aligned}
E^c_u(W)\,G\operatorname{PF}^c_u(N,P)
 &=R'(b_W)e_{j_!W}\,G(R\gamma)\,G\pi_p(A,P)\\
 &=R'(b_W H\gamma)e_C\,G\pi_p(A,P)\\
 &=R'(\gamma')R'(b_N\otimes1)\pi_{p'}(HA,GP)(e_A\otimes1).
\end{aligned}$$
The last line substitutes the open identity and then the proper-factor identity of step 2. Functoriality of $R'$ accounts for the composition inside $R'$. All tensor and pullback identifications are the ones fixed in steps 1–3.

source.place: Tag 0E48 (remark-compatible-with-diagram) and Tag 0GL1 (lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor); paste the two factor squares

proof.text:
The naturality in the first input of the counit-defined projection transformation is included in [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact]. Apply it for $p'$ to $b_N:HA\to j'_!VN$ and the second input $GP$:
$$R'(b_N\otimes1)\pi_{p'}(HA,GP)=\pi_{p'}(j'_!VN,GP)(R'b_N\otimes1).$$
Substitution into the last line of step 4 gives
$$\begin{aligned}
E^c_u(W)\,G\operatorname{PF}^c_u(N,P)
 &=R'(\gamma')\pi_{p'}(j'_!VN,GP)(R'b_N\,e_A\otimes1)\\
 &=\operatorname{PF}^{c'}_{u'}(VN,GP)(E^c_u(N)\otimes1),
\end{aligned}$$
which is the required equality with the stated comparisons. Naturality in $N,P$ follows from naturality of $e,\pi,b,\gamma$ and the pullback/tensor comparisons. No inverse of $e$ or $\pi$ occurs.
